newsitem.title: FRANCE: South Africa's Mbeki to visit Mobutu in Kinshasa.
newsitem.headline: South Africa's Mbeki to visit Mobutu in Kinshasa.

text.p: South African Deputy President Thabo Mbeki plans to visit Zairean President Mobutu Sese Seko in Kinshasa on Sunday for talks on the rebellion in eastern Zaire, an aide to Mobutu said on Saturday.

Mbeki attended a summit of African leaders in Nairobi on Wednesday that called for an immediate ceasefire in Africa's third largest country. The meeting would probably take place in Kinshasa in the afternoon, the aide said.
Mobutu returned home to Kinshasa on Friday from a mansion on the French Riviera near Nice, where he had been convalescing after prostate cancer surgery last year.
